descriptor.scene: Maya is the subject, and her closed silver laptop stays tucked under her left arm through the whole action. Maya is the subject, caught mid-dig in a deep, clean-walled foundation pit opened in the green of her own plot, driving a long-handled spade into the earth one-handed with her right hand and right boot while her left arm keeps the closed silver laptop pinned to her side, sleeves pushed to the elbow, face set with cheerful determination. Her full figure reads about a third of the frame height, her head about one-twelfth: close enough to feel the effort. The pit around her is the deepest thing on the plain, its walls cut straight and true, neat stakes and string marking its square edge, fresh earth piled tidily beside it. Behind and beyond her plot, neighbor towers are already rising fast against the sky, tall and pale and half-blurred with speed, while her ground holds nothing but the hole. Warm working daylight. Composition: Maya and her pit fill the left and center; the lower right of the frame stays calm grass and string-line.
negatives: Maya without the closed silver laptop under her left arm
the pit ragged, collapsing or muddy (its walls are clean and true)
descriptor._caption: Maya walks her plot before she builds anything. Then she digs. To carry a tall building, the ground has to be opened deep first. The tallest towers on the plain start as the deepest holes.
